journey.name: blocked manual request retry
journey.description: Requires two incoming one-time Bitcoin requests A and B in a funded disposable regtest wallet, normal payment PIN enabled, and an unresolved software on-chain receipt belonging to A. Creating the controlled unresolved receipt is a manual fixture prerequisite; a seeded receipt must be labelled as state injection, not evidence of a native failure. A and B must have distinct request identities. Record the original amount, recipient and transaction ID for A before starting. The original-payment retry journey provides the existing recovery steps. Backend confirmation and exactly-once payment verification remain manual checks. Never use real BTC or USDT for this fixture.

actions.action: Open incoming request B and verify its requested amount and recipient on the confirmation screen
Swipe to pay and complete the normal payment PIN authorization without recording entered digits
Verify the retained original payment A is shown as pending and no success is reported for B
Verify A still shows its original amount and transaction ID
Complete A using its existing original-payment recovery flow and fresh fee and PIN approval when required
Reopen the unpaid request B from pending requests and verify its original amount and recipient
Swipe to pay and cancel the payment PIN; verify B remains unpaid
Reopen B, review its exact amount and fees, swipe to pay and complete a fresh payment PIN authorization
Verify B can complete once rather than failing because a previous manual payment is already recorded
